info.biography: 为蔡邕[yōng]之徒。其为人少言语，不饮酒，严厉正大，被张纮[hóng]推荐仕于孙权。孙权任命他为会稽郡丞，行太守事，后不断升迁，官至吴国丞相。顾雍为官，多进良言，有功于吴。

editionBoundary.explanation: The separately retained 2014 classic uses an Ending-phase Bingyi and chooses up to X total recipients. This current ordinary OL module uses the 2022 discard trigger, once per actual phase, and includes the owner plus up to X OTHER recipients. No old classic rule or implementation is changed. The 2022-08-12 test draft ending the current phase and other product variants are not adopted.
editionBoundary.oldGuideScope: Only unchanged Shenxing is supported by the 2016 guide: it may discard Hand and Equipment, including Silver Lion, and has no own-Play usage cap. Old Bingyi examples are not current timing or exclusive FAQ evidence.

verifiedFrontendFacts: ShenXing lHi is ACTIVE, exact two NORMAL|EQUIP DISCARD materials. Its special grant counters are only the separate BingYiPo borrowed-skill branch.
BingYi2 bmi is ASK, excludes self from selected targets, permits zero selected other targets, and reads its maximum from the network request Param.
The complete bmi class has no explicit HandCount>0 gate or phase-token quota check; timeLimitRound=MAX is not evidence that the server has no phase quota.
TargetCountMin=0 concerns selected OTHER recipients; it does not establish that an empty-hand reveal is a valid trigger.

sourceHierarchy.currentRuleText: Current official hero and direct client rows, cross-checked with the formal 2022 update.
sourceHierarchy.guide: The official-hosted 2016 community guide is secondary explanation for unchanged Shenxing only.
sourceHierarchy.exclusiveFaq: No dedicated current ordinary OL FAQ was found for empty hand, Judgment ownership, no-phase timing, regrant quota, or paid death/source-loss queues. The implementation choices below are not asserted as server FAQ rulings.

implementationInterpretations.adopted: Your cards means the original owned Hand or Equipment entities. A real foreign dismantlement completed through Processing is recognized by the exact immediately preceding owned discard entry and matching finish reason. A Judgment-zone removal does not qualify.
implementationInterpretations.limit: The generic discard source query supports Judgment for other skills, which alone is not evidence to expand this skill.

implementationInterpretations.adopted: Do not offer when the current hand is empty. Mixed-color hands remain a legal optional reveal, consume the actual-phase opportunity when accepted, and yield no draw. Declining consumes nothing.
implementationInterpretations.limit: The public bmi class contains no explicit empty-hand gate. The adopted nonempty requirement follows the executable show-all-hand contract, not an observed server rejection.

implementationInterpretations.adopted: Require the real phase key frozen on the completed discard batch. Track owner+skill+full actual phase token, across source removal/regrant or instance replacement. All six real phases and inserted phases count; restoring an existing phase token does not create another opportunity. No synthetic setup/Finished phase is created when no real phase key exists. The quota is spent at the accepted reveal, including a mixed reveal.
implementationInterpretations.limit: No dedicated no-phase or per-source-reset FAQ was found; bmi does not implement this server-side qualification.

implementationInterpretations.adopted: Freeze every actual hand entity, its current owner-effective suit/color and the hand count at the real public reveal. Printed snapshots remain the actual shown cards. Red, black and colorless are separate classifications; a colorless card cannot be treated as black by a false-red shortcut. Child draws or later suit changes do not re-evaluate the frozen color or X. No classic reveal-color behavior is changed.

After a uniform reveal, commit the owner plus zero through X selected other living players. Resolve the owner first, then selected others in the original actual-turn-owner action order. Each uses a separate native Draw1 and drains its real replacement/movement/HP/Dying/skill children before advancing. Once committed, source loss or owner death does not cancel living recipients; a dead recipient receives no new draw. Completion or game termination cannot pay the reveal or a finished draw again.
implementationInterpretations.limit: Recipient ordering and source-loss/death continuation are explicit implementation inferences, not a dedicated official FAQ.

implementationInterpretations.adopted: Use/response/recast/death cleanup/equipment replacement and a discard diverted before entering Discard do not qualify. The effect follows the original owned discard payment, not the last arbitrary movement or each incidental Wooden Ox spill card.

runtimeContract.receiptCollections: ShownCards, OtherRecipients and Recipients are copied into read-only collections at every init. DrawOutcome uses the existing frozen native outcome.
runtimeContract.publicReveal: SetProgramCardSet + RevealProgramBoundCards with ProgramCardsRevealedEvent; no fake HandRevealed child window. The log records the actual total shown count.
runtimeContract.pendingChoice: Private ordinary-bingyi prompt; toggle/confirm. Card names and all shown cards are public only through the real reveal. No private uniform-hand hint is added to public AI context.
runtimeContract.sourceLoss: Exact paid owning frame + scalar reveal proof; typed Resume/Movement and native draw returns preserve its parent cursor. No sidecar, synthetic draw or parallel pending object.
runtimeContract.scope: Only the current ordinary OL module; no schema, package version, global epoch, replay version or classic module change.

behaviorCoverage: Exact repeatable two-entity HE Shenxing payment, real Silver Lion recovery child and native draw return.
Six actual phases, real inserted Play and restored original phase token, foreign native Dismantlement and one accepted show per phase.
Current nonempty Hand reveal, frozen effective colors and X, Hongyan, skip, empty and mixed-color boundaries, mandatory self and zero to X distinct other recipients.
Real Zenrun replacement with ActualDrawIds empty, actual replacement material, compensation children, later recipient Draw1 and once-only cold completion.
Actual paid source loss and death retain issued live recipient obligations; a genuinely new skill instance cannot refresh the already spent phase quota.
Native Use, Played, recast, equipment replacement and Wooden Ox spill exclusions, private views, stale choices and JSON checkpoint replay.
verification.scope: The reviewed ordinary-only commit snapshot compiles and passes focused integration plus measured routine. Concurrent activities, Mou Cao Pi and draft changes are excluded from that snapshot and preserved in the main workspace. This is not a manual full run or interactive match acceptance.
